projects.name: Practical Defenses for Deployed AI Models
projects.description: A defense system protecting deployed AI models from adversarial attacks and membership inference, using inference-time defenses only — no retraining required.

partTwoResults.label: Part 2 — Training-Time + Inference-Time Defense (ResNet-18, CIFAR-100)
partTwoResults.note: MIA advantage was already near-zero pre-defense in this setup. Training-time and inference-time defenses proved complementary — the smaller accuracy drop here (8.72% vs. Part 1's 16.32%) suggests models trained with adversarial examples tolerate the inference-time pipeline better.

bullets: Built a defense system that protects AI models from two real attacks: one that tricks them into wrong answers, another that leaks whether someone's data was used to train them.

Raised accuracy under adversarial attack from 6.8% to 60.3% and cut membership inference advantage by about 95%, using inference-time defenses only, all without retraining the underlying model from scratch.
